name: A2A Agent Interoperability
description: Workflow for exposing or consuming Agent2Agent-compatible agent cards, tasks, streaming updates, and delegated work contracts.

chain.step: Decide whether Lilly is exposing an agent card, consuming another agent, or brokering tasks between agents.
Fetch the current protocol or vendor docs when protocol details may have changed.
Design agent card, skill declarations, auth, task lifecycle, streaming updates, artifact handling, and cancellation semantics.
Generate or validate schemas for agent card and task payloads.
Implement and verify with remote-cli-agent when the user asks to ship an endpoint or client.
